mentions.name: blase
mentions.description: A proof-of-concept language server for Laravel's Blade templating language, intended to eventually become a submodule inside a more general PHP language server.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on blase (https://github.com/bramadityaw/blase), a language server for Laravel's Blade templating language. This is a proof-of-concept project that I plan to make into a submodule inside a more general PHP language server.
